text.tspan: AI Hospitality Kiosk Platform: multi-tenant system architecture
One codebase, two modes (APP_MODE=cloud | edge). All money in integer LKR cents.
APP_MODE=cloud · central server · owns menu, tax, staff, devices, floor, plans
Tenant isolation: scoped dependency on every route (tenant_id / membership) + Postgres Row-Level Security backstop + require_feature(plan)
tenant_id on top-level + hot tables · RLS
Mini-PC in the venue · APP_MODE=edge · single venue · keeps working with no internet
LAN · REST + WebSocket (X-Device-Token + staff PIN session)
Small café, no mini-PC · devices talk to the cloud
Device screen (one shell app, renders by device type)
